# Yelp

5 endpoints (4 GET, 1 POST). Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 3 standard (1 credit), 2 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/yelp/business/info - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a unified Place for one Yelp business: name, alias URL, unrounded star rating on a 5-star scale, exact review count, price level, address, coordinates, categories, photos, and timezone. Identify the business by its 22-character Yelp encid, its alias (for example prince-street-pizza-new-york-2) or a Yelp /biz/ URL, as `id` or `url`; `place.id` is the encid whichever you send. A business that does not exist answers an auto-refunded error. If an alias with accented letters fails, send the 22-character id instead. Where the business publishes them, the page also carries its phone, whether the owner has claimed it (`place.verified`), its own description, its website (`place.ext.website`), its menu link (`place.ext.menu_url`), Yelp's amenity flags (`place.ext.attributes`, those it has and those it lacks) and the neighbourhoods Yelp lists (`place.ext.neighborhoods`); a leaf that could not be read in time is null. To find an id, start from GET /v1/yelp/search.

**Use when** you already have a Yelp encid. Alias slugs return not found. GET /v1/yelp/search finds businesses by term and location.
**Cost** cache 900 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Yelp business encid, the 22-character opaque id (for example zj8Lq1T8KIC5zwFief15jg for Prince Street Pizza). The alias from its Yelp URL (for example prince-street-pizza-new-york-2) also works; place.id is the encid either way. Send the 22-character id if an alias with accented letters fails. · e.g. `zj8Lq1T8KIC5zwFief15jg`
- `url` (optional, string) - Yelp business URL. Encid and alias URLs both work, for example https://www.yelp.com/biz/prince-street-pizza-new-york-2; query strings such as ?osq= are ignored.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL (only when the fallback source serves) |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. (only when the fallback source serves) |
| `place.latitude` | Latitude in decimal degrees. |

+17 more (types in the full schema): `place` {longitude, phone, price_level, reviews_count, verified}; `place.ext` {attributes, faqs, history, menu_url, neighborhoods, popular_dishes, specialties, website, year_established, closed}; `place.rating` {max, value}. Also in the sample: `place` {category string, image_urls string[]} (+7 more).

**Next** `yelp/business/reviews` (`id` ← `data.place.id`) - Get Yelp reviews for a business.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/yelp/business/info" \
  --data-urlencode "id=zj8Lq1T8KIC5zwFief15jg" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/yelp/business/reviews - 1-5 credits (request-shaped)

Returns a unified ReviewList of customer reviews for a Yelp business. Identify the business by its 22-character encid, by the alias in its Yelp URL, or by the URL itself (`id` or `url`). Each page has 10 reviews with cursor pagination, ISO timestamps, owner replies, photo URLs, and language. sort=newest returns the most recent reviews first; oldest, highest_rated and lowest_rated are also available, and the default is Yelp's recommended order. HELPFUL vote counts are filled in the default order for an encid; with another sort or an alias they are null. Page 2 does not overlap page 1. A business that does not exist returns 404 (auto-refunded). A business with no reviews returns an empty page and is not billed. limit (1 to 49 a page), rating, query (words in the review), language and sort=elites narrow or reorder the reviews; with rating, query or language, total counts only the matching reviews. Send the same filters with the cursor on later pages. not_recommended=true returns instead the reviews Yelp hides from the business page (its "not recommended" reviews), 10 a page, for a business named by its encid. Each review carries `review.ext.yelp`: its votes, keyed reactions, photos with captions, the reviewer's friend and photo counts and Elite years.

**Use when** you want to read or monitor a business's reviews, newest first with sort=newest. A Yelp URL copied from the browser works as url. Page 2 does not overlap page 1.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Pricing** 1 credit per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free. With `max_pages`, `max_items` or `max_credits`, each page walked is billed at this price (a cached page is free), and `max_credits` caps the total.
**Paging** cursor · ≈10/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · price per N items not proven · typical 2.4-2.5 s

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Yelp business id: the 22-character encid (for example zj8Lq1T8KIC5zwFief15jg for Prince Street Pizza) or the alias from its Yelp URL (for example prince-street-pizza-new-york-2). review.entity_id echoes the id you send. · e.g. `zj8Lq1T8KIC5zwFief15jg`
- `url` (optional, string) - Yelp business URL as copied from the browser, for example https://www.yelp.com/biz/prince-street-pizza-new-york-2. Alias and encid URLs both work, on yelp.com and Yelp's country domains (yelp.co.uk, yelp.ca); query strings such as ?osq= are ignored. review.entity_id echoes the name or id in the URL.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Opaque cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit on page 1.
- `sort` (optional, enum: recommended | newest | oldest | highest_rated | lowest_rated | elites) - Review order. recommended (the default) is Yelp's recommended order. newest returns the most recent reviews first, oldest the earliest first, highest_rated 5 stars first, lowest_rated 1 star first, elites reviews by Yelp Elite members first. Later pages keep page 1's order: send the same sort or omit it with the cursor.
- `not_recommended` (optional, boolean) - When true, returns the reviews Yelp hides from the business page ("not recommended" by its filter), 10 a page with the same cursor paging, total being how many it hides. Needs the 22-character encid (`id`, or a /biz/ URL carrying it; an alias is refused with a free 400) and no `sort`. Each review has its id, rating, text, date and reviewer, and the owner's reply when there is one; photos and language are null. Default false.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-49) - Reviews a page, 1 to 49 (default 10).
- `rating` (optional, string) - Only reviews with these star ratings, 1 to 5, comma-separated, for example 5 or 1,2.
- `query` (optional, string) - Only reviews that mention these words, for example parking (up to 200 characters).
- `language` (optional, string) - Only reviews in this language, for example en, fr or es. total then counts that language's reviews.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off the page, and the page that reaches one ends the walk: `next_cursor` is not returned and `pagination.stopped_at` is `since`. Sending it sets the newest-first sort shown in this endpoint's sort parameter (any other sort value is a free 400). The page still costs what a page costs, so you pay for the pages you walk and no more. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` (1) · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality); `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.
- `since` requires `sort=newest` (auto-injected when `sort` is absent; a different value is a free 400).
- `reports`, `label_evidence` are no-ops without `label` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `goal`, `fit_tokens` are no-ops without `fit` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `label`: at most 5 comma-separated values.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `review.author.name` | Reviewer name. |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |

+11 more (types in the full schema): `review` {language}; `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review.author` {avatar_url, location, reviews_count}; `review.ext` {yelp}; `review.rating` {value}. Also in the sample: `review` {url string, title null, helpful_votes number, verified null, source null, original_language null}; `review.rating` {max number}; `review.author` {url string} (+7 more). Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/yelp/business/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "id=zj8Lq1T8KIC5zwFief15jg" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## POST /v1/yelp/business/reviews/history - 1-154 credits (request-shaped)

Starts a background job (202) that collects every review of one Yelp business, newest first, including businesses that have closed. The body takes exactly one of `id` (the business id or alias) or `url` (a yelp.com/biz/ link), and optionally `since` and `until` (YYYY-MM-DD, whole UTC days), `languages` (`all` by default, or a comma list such as `en,fr`) and `max_reviews` (1 to 100,000). Any other field is a free 400. The 202 returns `data.job_id`, `status`, `pages_read`, `reviews_collected`, `credits_hold`, `credits_charged` (null until the job settles) and `expires_at` (7 days). A business that cannot be read is a free 502. Read the reviews 100 at a time with GET /v1/yelp/business/reviews/history/{job_id}?offset=&limit=, which costs 0 credits and returns the same review objects as GET /v1/yelp/business/reviews. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retried submit return the same job without a second hold.

**Use when** you need a business's whole review history or a dated window of it, such as the last two years, rather than one page.
**Cost** price depends on how many items the request sends or returns · not cached
**Pricing** 1 credit per started 4 pages of up to 49 reviews, at least 1. Submitting holds the most the request can read, set by the request alone: 52 credits for each language asked for (`languages=all`, the default, is held as 3 languages, 154 credits), or less when `max_reviews` is set. The job settles to the pages it read and refunds the rest; a business that cannot be read is refunded in full.
**Execution** Async job: pass `webhook_url` to be told when it completes instead of polling.
**Paging** none

**Body params** (JSON)

- `id` (optional, string) - The Yelp business id or alias, for example la-folie-san-francisco-2. Send this or `url`. · e.g. `la-folie-san-francisco-2`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Yelp business link, for example https://www.yelp.com/biz/la-folie-san-francisco-2. Send this or `id`.
- `since` (optional, string) - Only reviews on or after this UTC day, as YYYY-MM-DD. · e.g. `2024-11-20`
- `until` (optional, string) - Only reviews on or before this UTC day, as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `languages` (optional, string) - `all` (the default: every language the business has reviews in) or a comma list of language codes, such as `en,fr`. Sets the hold: 52 credits per language listed, and `all` is held as 3 languages (154 credits) whatever the business lists; every language is still collected.
- `max_reviews` (optional, integer) - Stop after this many reviews, an integer from 1 to 100,000. Lowers the hold to the pages it needs (49 reviews a page, plus one per language).

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Analytics` async job: this call returns `job_id`; poll `GET /v1/yelp/business/reviews/history/{job_id}` for status, and the result comes back there once it completes. Job envelope (inferred from a sample): {job_id string, status string, business string, pages_read number, reviews_collected number, credits_hold number, credits_charged null, expires_at string}; `languages[]` {language string, reviews_listed number, done boolean}.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/yelp/business/reviews/history" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"id":"la-folie-san-francisco-2"}'
```

## GET /v1/yelp/search - 1 credit (standard)

Searches Yelp businesses by term and location. Returns a unified PlaceList of 10 businesses a page: the 22-character encid as place.id (use it on GET /v1/yelp/business/info and /v1/yelp/business/reviews), name, Yelp URL, unrounded star rating, review count, price level, address, coordinates, categories, and photos, with the total number of matches. Results are in Yelp's recommended order; sort=rating and sort=review_count are refused with a free 400. ads=true adds sponsored businesses after the regular results, marked as sponsored. bbox (west,north,east,south) searches inside a map box instead, the way to cover more than Yelp's 240 results by tiling a region; box rows carry no coordinates, ZIP code, state or phone. Page with cursor from next_cursor. A location Yelp does not cover returns an empty list and is not billed.

**Use when** you want to find businesses before business/info. query and location are required. If the provider reports a non-zero total with no rows, the call fails and is refunded.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** cursor · ≈10/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 1 credits · typical 1.8-2.0 s

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search term as typed on Yelp, for example Pizza or coffee. · e.g. `Pizza`
- `location` (required) - City or full location string, for example New York, NY or San Francisco, CA, United States. Required with query. · e.g. `New York, NY`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit on page 1. Pages hold 10 regular businesses (plus any sponsored ones when ads=true); the cursor is a numeric offset such as 10.
- `sort` (optional, enum: recommended | rating | review_count) - Result order. Only recommended (the default, Yelp's recommended order) is served. rating and review_count are refused with a free 400: no source can order Yelp search by them. To rank by rating or review count, sort the returned items by place.rating.value or place.reviews_count yourself.
- `ads` (optional, boolean) - When true, sponsored businesses are added after the page's regular results, each marked with place.ext.is_ad set to true. Default false.
- `bbox` (optional, string) - Map box to search inside, as four decimal-degree numbers: west,north,east,south (longitude, latitude, longitude, latitude), for example -122.43,37.77,-122.40,37.75. Yelp shows at most 240 results for one search; total is the number of matches in the box, so to cover a whole city tile it into boxes and split any box whose total is 240 into four. Rows from a box search carry no coordinates, ZIP code, state or phone (the page says so in a warning); place.address is the street and city. query and location are still required, cursor pages the box 10 at a time, and the price is the same. Yelp can move a business between pages of a box from one call to the next, so when you collect a whole box, keep one row per place.id.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL (only when the fallback source serves) |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.latitude` | Latitude in decimal degrees. |
| `place.longitude` | Longitude in decimal degrees. |

+3 more (types in the full schema): `place` {price_level, reviews_count}; `place.rating` {value}. Also in the sample: `place` {category string, phone null, verified null, description null, image_urls string[], categories string[]}; `place.rating` {max number}. Empty on every row the field-health check sampled (22/11/2026), so not returned today: `place.ext.is_ad`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

**Next** `yelp/business/reviews` (`id` ← `data.items[].place.id`) - Get Yelp reviews for a business. · `yelp/business/info` (`id` ← `data.items[].place.id`) - Get a Yelp business by id, alias or URL.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/yelp/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=Pizza" \
  --data-urlencode "location=New York, NY" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/yelp/search/suggestions` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
